::: {#def-in-context-learning}

#### In-context learning

**In-context learning** is a [pretrained](attention-transformers.qmd#def-pretraining) [language model](language-models.qmd#def-language-model) doing a task from a description of it,
or a few examples of it,
written into its input,
with no change to its [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) [@brown2020language, sections 1, 2].
With no examples the prompt is *zero-shot*,
with one it is *one-shot*,
and with a few it is *few-shot*.

:::
